nodes.label: graphify-out/graph.json
nodes.rationale: Rewritten whole on every build, so large PR diffs are expected and should not be flagged as churn.

nodes.label: graphify usage rules
nodes.rationale: Query the scoped graph (query/path/explain/section) before grep or raw file reads because it returns a much smaller subgraph than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output; keep graph current with AST-only update after code changes (no API cost).

nodes.label: GET-only GAS communication
nodes.rationale: Writes are also sent as GET query params so GAS receives them via e.parameter reliably; memo capped at 500 chars to avoid overly long URLs.
